meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 它把旧版 NanoClaw 和 Claude 的记忆迁进统一的 memory/ 目录,并整理成 instructions.prepend.md。整个过程由运行本技能的 coding harness 执行,链接会被隔离,最后给出源到目标的迁移报告。
howto.when: 更新提示出现 shared-memory 破坏性变更后,或某 group 仍留有 .seed.md、旧 CLAUDE.md 等旧记忆文件时触发;你说“migrate memory”也会触发。

say.text: 帮我把旧记忆迁到共享 memory 树里
say.note: 先列出受影响的 group,等你确认再动手

say.text: 这个 group 切换后好像失忆了,查一下旧记忆
迁移前先暂停这个 group 的待办任务
say.note: 暂停 pending 任务并记录可回滚的改名

howto.what_en: It moves legacy NanoClaw and Claude memory into the shared memory/ tree and provider-neutral instructions.prepend.md. The coding harness stages, indexes and verifies files, quarantines links, and gives a source-to-destination report.
howto.when_en: Runs after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md or Claude auto-memory. Also triggers on "migrate memory" or "legacy memory".

say_en.text: Migrate our legacy memory into the shared memory tree.
say_en.note: It lists affected groups and waits for approval.

say_en.text: The agent forgot everything after the switch - check its legacy memory.
say_en.note: Looks for .seed.md, CLAUDE.md and other leftovers.

say_en.text: Pause this group's pending tasks before migrating memory.
say_en.note: Pauses pending series and records reversible renames.
